title: 3/25/26: Partly Cloudy Day Peaks at 73, Evening Remains Mild - NewsBreak
text:
By Source Staff ,
7 hours ago As of 5:05 PM in Wilson County, the current temperature stands at 73.2°F, with mainly partly cloudy skies. Winds are flowing at a speed of 12.6 mph, and there has been no precipitation recorded.
Today, Wilson County experienced a high of 73.2°F and a low of 48.7°F along with overcast conditions. Winds reached up to 14 mph with a negligible precipitation chance of just 2%, and no rainfall was recorded.
Tonight, the temperature is expected to drop to a low of 63.5°F with continued partly cloudy skies. Wind speeds will maintain up to 12.2 mph, and similarly, the precipitation chance will remain low at 2%, indicating another largely dry evening ahead.
Residents should enjoy the stable weather conditions without concern for immediate weather alerts or significant shifts in the forecast.
